pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 150 °C·d above 7 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1100 °C·d$(). Best near 18 °C; stops above 30 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -1.5 °C (-1.5 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5-6.5 (tolerates 4.5-7.5). Roots 0.5 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 150, P 25, K 220 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 312 cwt/ac (35 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Potato.
